issue_request: FHIR-21287 asked to add SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.testingDestination so ordering systems can distinguish where a specimen will actually be tested. The final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution changed the proposed string to CodeableConcept and recorded the change as pre-applied for R5.
initial_application: The change was pre-applied in 165c638234, which added SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.testingDestination as 0..* CodeableConcept in the then-authoritative SpecimenDefinition spreadsheet source with a TestingDestination example binding to diagnostic-service-sections. Commit 33b409a4b6 later converted SpecimenDefinition into StructureDefinition XML and preserved that element and binding.
additional_context: SpecimenDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml is in current build scope. OO's 2021-04-29 block vote listed FHIR-21287 as persuasive with modification and pre-applied, matching the Jira vote. Later searches found no Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence reversing or narrowing testingDestination.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already defines SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.testingDestination with cardinality 0..*, type CodeableConcept, the approved destination definition, and the diagnostic-service-sections example binding.
